title: Correlations from officially sourced numbers only, with n on every value

rows.definition: (home - away) points vs (home + away) points, one pair per played game
rows.why: this is the dependence that makes a same-game parlay of side and total invalid when marginals are multiplied; it is measured, never assumed
rows.method: Pearson r on officially sourced numbers only; Fisher-z interval is a floor on width because games inside a week share a slate; two-sided permutation test
rows.provenance: 149 rows inherited from nfl-live-board/data/corpus_rows_only.json (each with its own game-centre URL) + 1 rows verified by this session on 2026-11-19

rows.why: the brief requires the availability signal to be a surprise, not a level; a level correlation would need one dated report per club-week
rows.blank_reason: the repository holds dated reports for 2 weeks (2026-11-15 Week 10, 2026-11-18/19 Week 11). With 2 report-weeks there is no cross-sectional sample of levels, and the value would be invented. n=0 is published instead.

rows.why: closing line value is the luck-free market score
rows.blank_reason: no official or licensed opening/closing price exists anywhere in this repository or on any NFL page; a CLV correlation cannot be computed without fabricating prices

rows.pair: snap-share of a replaced starter ~ game total adjustment
rows.why: the depth-of-replacement measure the brief asks for
rows.blank_reason: no official snap-count source has been located and licensed; replacement depth is therefore not modelled - see the suggestion that decides this before any feature is built
